nodes.label: Registration form
nodes.rationale: Fields: username, password, confirm password. Error states: username taken, weak password names the broken rule, password mismatch.

nodes.label: Register / log in wireframe
nodes.rationale: Route /accounts/register/. Registration form with validation states; log in form below it.

nodes.label: dj_database_url with ssl_require
nodes.rationale: TLS to Heroku Postgres in production without breaking local non-TLS connections.

nodes.label: DEBUG defaults to False
nodes.rationale: Forgetting to set DEBUG on Heroku fails safe rather than open.

nodes.label: AUTH_PASSWORD_VALIDATORS (all four)
nodes.rationale: Keeps Django's four validators so US01's complex-password requirement works.

nodes.label: Production-only security hardening
nodes.rationale: SSL redirect, secure cookies and HSTS only when not DEBUG so local HTTP still works; check --deploy clean.

nodes.label: Production-only hashed static storage
nodes.rationale: Manifest storage needs collectstatic, which tests and runserver never run; plain storage used when DEBUG or TESTING.

nodes.label: SECRET_KEY with no default
nodes.rationale: App refuses to start without a key rather than falling back to an insecure one.

nodes.label: Username-and-password-only auth
nodes.rationale: No email collected, so nothing to verify and no email service to configure.

nodes.label: Empty state message
nodes.rationale: 'Your cards list is empty. Browse cards to add your first one.' links to catalogue.

nodes.label: Card entries table
nodes.rationale: Columns: card, set, status, qty, actions (Edit, Remove; 'Got it!' for Wanted entries). Becomes stacked cards on small screens.

nodes.label: Status tabs (All / Owned / Wanted)
nodes.rationale: Status filter switches the table below.

nodes.label: Collection summary figures
nodes.rationale: Total owned, unique owned, estimated value; value ignores Wanted cards and cards with no price.

nodes.label: Add / edit card entry form
nodes.rationale: Fields: status (Owned/Wanted), quantity, notes. Duplicate error and quantity <= 0 validation.

nodes.label: Remove confirmation
nodes.rationale: 'Remove Charizard from your cards? This cannot be undone.'

nodes.label: My Cards stacked rows
nodes.rationale: Table replaced by stacked cards with Edit/Remove on mobile.

nodes.label: My Cards wireframe
nodes.rationale: Route /cards/mine/ (logged in). Success message, Owned/Wanted/All tabs, summary figures and a table of entries with Edit and Remove.

nodes.label: Forms and confirmations wireframe
nodes.rationale: Routes /cards/<id>/add/, /cards/mine/<id>/edit/, /cards/mine/<id>/delete/. Add/edit form, delete confirmation and message styles.

nodes.label: Mobile layout wireframe
nodes.rationale: Route /cards/mine/ at 360px wide. Collapsed mobile menu and My Cards as stacked cards instead of a table.

nodes.label: Card grid
nodes.rationale: Each tile shows card name, set, number and rarity; '48 cards found' count.

nodes.label: Add to My Cards control
nodes.rationale: One combined control: Owned/Wanted choice plus quantity. Logged out: replaced by 'Log in to add this card'.

nodes.label: Card info panel
nodes.rationale: Name, set, number, rarity, market price and average star rating with review count.

nodes.label: Write a review form
nodes.rationale: Star rating (click to rate) plus text.

nodes.label: Card detail wireframe
nodes.rationale: Route /cards/<id>/. Card details, one combined add-to-My-Cards control, and the review list.

nodes.label: Card placeholder image
nodes.rationale: Shown when a card has no picture; reads 'No image yet'.

nodes.label: clear_expired_cache release command
nodes.rationale: Django only clears expired cache rows past 300, so IP-holding rate-limit notes are purged on every release

nodes.label: Age check (under-13 refusal, COPPA/Children's Code)
nodes.rationale: Date of birth checked and thrown away, never stored

nodes.label: Brand and design (collector's vault)
nodes.rationale: Calm premium look so card artwork is the star, with Game Boy red/yellow/blue accents; every text colour pair passes WCAG AA

nodes.label: Heavy traffic handling (gunicorn 2x4, 10s query timeout)
nodes.rationale: 8 concurrent requests per dyno, worker restarts after ~1000 requests, search cut to 100 chars/5 words

nodes.label: ALLAUTH_TRUSTED_PROXY_COUNT = 1
nodes.rationale: Uses the last X-Forwarded-For entry added by Heroku's router, which cannot be faked; fixed bug #66 where every visitor shared one count

nodes.label: Content Security Policy and security headers
nodes.norm_label: content security policy and security headers

nodes.label: Private vulnerability reporting
nodes.rationale: Reports go through GitHub Security tab, not public issues; reply within 3 days, credited in bug log, no paid bounty

nodes.label: Accessibility testing (axe WCAG 2.2 AA, Lighthouse, WAVE)
nodes.norm_label: accessibility testing (axe wcag 2.2 aa, lighthouse, wave)

nodes.label: Automated test suite (221 tests)
nodes.rationale: Two-user tests are most important: they prove a security boundary that one user cannot touch another's records

nodes.label: Bug #41 Wait for CI with no CI
nodes.norm_label: bug #41 wait for ci with no ci

nodes.label: Load testing (2,000 visits, 25 concurrent)
nodes.rationale: 50 timeouts in run 2 were the test computer's TLS connection limit, not the site's

nodes.label: Layered security architecture
nodes.rationale: Defence in depth: if one protection fails another still stands; HTTPS/HSTS, router, gunicorn, middleware, rate limits, user-scoped views, ORM, encrypted Postgres

nodes.label: Least data stored
nodes.rationale: Only username, PBKDF2-hashed password, cards and reviews; little personal data to lose

nodes.label: US28 Manage data in Django admin
nodes.norm_label: us28 manage data in django admin

nodes.label: CardVault web app
nodes.rationale: Full-stack Django/PostgreSQL app on Heroku demonstrating full CRUD behind a real login, per the Code Institute capstone checklist

nodes.label: Django admin (superusers only)
nodes.rationale: Admin login form disabled so admins use the rate-limited login; owner keeps a separate hidden superuser so the most powerful account is hardest to target

nodes.label: Branded error pages (400/403/404/429/500)
nodes.rationale: 500 page is plain HTML with no context so a broken database cannot break the error page

nodes.label: Heroku deployment
nodes.rationale: App cardvault, EU region, Basic dyno, Postgres essential-0; automatic deploys from GitHub main since 14 Oct 2026

nodes.label: Single source of message wording
nodes.rationale: Keeps templates and views consistent so testers check the same strings the views use

nodes.label: Heroku Wait for CI to pass before deploy
nodes.norm_label: heroku wait for ci to pass before deploy
nodes.rationale: Ensures a commit with failing tests can never reach the live site

nodes.label: Static 500 Page Without Template Tags
nodes.rationale: Hardcoded /static paths and links so it renders even when the app or template context fails

nodes.label: Logout as POST
nodes.rationale: Logging out requires POST to avoid CSRF-triggered logouts

nodes.label: Under-13 Date of Birth Age Check
nodes.norm_label: under-13 date of birth age check
nodes.rationale: Registration closes after an under-13 attempt (US29) for child safety

nodes.label: Poke Ball 1-5 Rating
nodes.rationale: Real radio buttons filled by CSS so rating stays accessible to keyboard and screen readers

nodes.label: Contact Form Bot Trap (Honeypot)
nodes.rationale: Hidden field via CSS traps bots on the Contact form

nodes.label: Messages Use Word and Colour
nodes.rationale: Status conveyed by text as well as colour for accessibility

nodes.label: Hashed IP Contact Rate Limit
nodes.rationale: Keeps a one-way scrambled IP for an hour only, to stop bot floods without storing the address

nodes.label: Contact honeypot and 5/hour limit
nodes.rationale: Limit keyed on a one-way hash of the IP, never the address; site sends no email so it cannot relay mail

nodes.label: Login and registration rate limits (django-allauth)
nodes.rationale: 3 wrong passwords lock a username 15 minutes; trade-off accepts lockout-by-others for a hobby site, a bank would add 2FA

nodes.rationale: Removed to keep focus on CRUD; prices bring currencies, exchange rates and upkeep

nodes.label: Won't if tier

nodes.rationale: Runs flake8, manage.py check, makemigrations --check and the test suite against a throwaway PostgreSQL 18 service

nodes.label: Bandit findings and # nosec decisions
nodes.rationale: 21 findings, none high; each safe line carries # nosec with a justification

nodes.label: Card model
nodes.rationale: One row per printed card shared by all users; unique (card_set, number); image optional; market_price removed 15 Oct 2026

nodes.label: CardSet model
nodes.rationale: Cut then restored 12 Oct 2026: a string set_name had nowhere to hold set size and risked inconsistent spelling

nodes.label: CollectionEntry model
nodes.rationale: One table with OWNED/WANTED status replaces two near-identical tables; unique (user, card) makes Got it! a one-field change; quantity >= 1

nodes.label: Review model
nodes.rationale: Unique (user, card); rating 1-5 enforced by a check constraint as well as form validators

nodes.label: User (django.contrib.auth)
nodes.rationale: Built-in User gives register/login/logout, so a custom model earns nothing
